issue_request: FHIR-33036 is an Applied FHIR-core Observation request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, to support v2 OBX-30 Observation Sub-Type with a standard Observation extension named observation-structure-type using CodeableConcept and an extensible binding to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v2-0937.
initial_application: No core HL7/fhir source or history entry for FHIR-33036 or observation-structure-type was found. HL7/fhir-extensions commit 5e8c023 added input/definitions/Observation/StructureDefinition-observation-structureType.xml, and merge commit 0651ee1 landed it via PR #126 with the FHIR-33036 key.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini confirms Observation is active in the core build, but global extension definitions now live in the Extension Pack. The Extension Pack file matches the Jira resolution. OO Confluence minutes support the block-vote and vote-cleanup path; Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion. Later FHIR-53016 is Triaged/unresolved for a possible value set update, while FHIR-53017 is a published Extension Pack decision deprecating observation-secondaryFinding in favor of observation-structure-type.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The required extension artifact already exists in HL7/fhir-extensions, so duplicating it in the core checkout would be incorrect.
